subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw core support third-party passive-capture imports, and if so which initial producer/version and provenance and completeness contract should become supported?
rationale: Accepting external producer schemas establishes a lasting compatibility and data-ownership contract that source inspection cannot choose safely on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Support Scrollmark bundle v1
options.body: Implement only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle initially, with explicit provenance and partial-collection semantics.

options.title: Require an external converter
options.body: Keep Birdclaw’s core importer limited to Birdclaw-owned formats and document conversion into its canonical backup representation.

options.title: Decline capture imports
options.body: Retain official archives and Birdclaw live transports as the only supported ingestion sources.

recommendation.title: Support Scrollmark bundle v1
recommendation.body: Implement only the versioned Scrollmark canonical bundle initially, with explicit provenance and partial-collection semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the vision and recent canonical persistence behavior that defines this product boundary.
